caption: The drawing shows a wooden wall clock mounted vertically, with a rectangular case made of a reddish-brown wood and detailed with fine grain texture. The clock's upper section is enclosed by three gold-colored finials—one in the center and one at each side of the top edge. Inside the upper part of the clock, there is a silver-gray bell mounted above a circular clock face. The clock face itself is yellowish with black Roman numerals marking the hours and black clock hands. The background of the drawing is plain, off-white, and unadorned, which emphasizes the clock as the sole subject of the composition. The artist’s signature, "Dorothea A. Farrington, The Federal Art Project," appears in small writing at the bottom right corner.
title: Wall Clock Antique
